security_cases: normal use performs no third-party content transmission
user-controlled strings render through textContent or escaped text
secret-bearing controls are not persisted to localStorage
file/text parsers have explicit size/count bounds
downloads use fixed/sanitized filenames and Blob URLs
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport has no page-level horizontal scroll
result region uses role=status and aria-live=polite
large tables/previews scroll inside their card
performance_cases: large-file operations are user-triggered and bounded
expensive crypto benchmarks use bounded parameters
no normal calculation requires a Cloudflare Worker
